logic: The QR symbol of each SPAYD text of payment/spayd.json, under the same case name, at error correction H as ZXing 3.5.4 encodes it with the ISO-8859-1 hint (the encoder of v2's GET /api/donations/payment-qr, which slice 1.4 removed): error correction, version, mode, ECI header, mask and matrix. The browser draws every payment QR with its own encoder from slice 1.4 and runs every case (since 1.3); the backend encodes each text through ZXing as the independent check until slice 1.10. Since the texts ask for an instant payment (PT:IP, Jakub 2026-11-06) their symbols are ZXing 3.5.4's, encoded outside the repository by a program that first gave every earlier symbol of this file byte for byte
